t: Flomasta PipeGrip Straight Reducer is a push-fit water pipe fitting designed to reduce 28mm pipe to 15mm with a secure, leak-free connection. Its dual locking system and green band indicator ensure a reliable seal with no hot works required. WRAS approved and copper and plastic pipe compatible, it’s perfect for clean, smooth transitions in plumbing systems.
